result.Method of Attack: Trojanized VS Code extensions targeting Solidity developers on Windows that deliver multi-stage obfuscated malware, steal cryptocurrency wallet credentials, establish persistence via malicious browser extension and executable, disable Windows Defender and security features, exfiltrate victim data and credentials to attacker infrastructure, use command and control domains relevant to Solidity to avoid detection, payload hidden inside image file on Internet Archive, inject malicious Chromium-based browser extension, deploy infostealer and Quasar RAT
result.Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Visual Studio Code, Solidity developers' environments, Chromium-based browsers
result.Attack Vector: Malicious VS Code extensions installed from VS Code Marketplace, PowerShell scripts executed via extension.js, Browser extension injection via modified browser shortcuts, Multi-stage payload download and execution from C2 servers
result.Indicators of Compromise: VS Code extensions: solaibot.vsix (SHA256: 209fb5bb2440ffe1a631dfe3b574229105a33c5153eded023cc77d8e8f81d1de), among-eth.vsix (ce72b79e324371134db762fe70b8b1789af899d7217461bc3658a6bd84743eb6), blankebesxstnion.vsix (e19d5d8f941b9a98fbb3b65e1e6077fa00d97529e351e455297b0204ec07e9ed), Malicious payloads: extension.zip (e0ca66c1a9a68b319b24a7c6b8fdca219dffd802dd4de2d59f602c4d90f40d6c), myau.exe (c5c0228a1e0ba2bb748219325f66acf17078a26165b45728d8e98150377aa068), myaunet.exe (a1eadd41327bd8736e275627d3953944fe7089c032d72a3e429ff18ad0958ada), wmam.exe (c3684164933c3f54d5b0b242a8a906a85d633de479079a820bb804c0f73c0f58), C2 domains: solidity[.]bot, myaunet[.]su, paste[.]ee, archive[.]org/download/new_image_20250509_1852/new_image.jpg, m-vn[.]ws/bird.php, begalinokotobananinotrippitroppacrocofanclub[.]su, PowerShell commands with ExecutionPolicy Bypass downloading scripts from solidity[.]bot, Modified browser shortcuts to load malicious extension from APPDATA\CheckExtension, Use of User-Agent 'MyauNET/1.0' in HTTP requests, Registry keys under HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft for persistence, Disabling Windows Defender features and adding exclusions, Modification of Windows hosts file and firewall rules to block security updates
